answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 150230 Country: INDIA Title: I would like to know more on Aqeedah (Beliefs) Question: I would like to know more on Aqeedah (Beliefs). I would be very grateful to you if you could please send me in detail a copy of the basic beliefs regarding Allah, Prophets and Angels etc. that a Muslim must have to enter Jannah. Answer ID: 150230 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 943/900/M=7/1438) Your question demands a lengthy answer, hence you are advised to study the book “Bahishti Zewar” by Hadhrat Maulana Ashraf Ali Thanvi (may Allah have mercy upon him) and “Talimul Islam” by Hadhrat Mufti Kifayatullah Sahib Dehlavi (may Allah have mercy upon him). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
